pages.title: Merging Potions
pages.text: Ordinary potions can be poured into a tank containing Mundane Hexbrew and turned into drinkable Witch Hexbrew. Start with a full bucket of fluid. Each merge produces 250 mB—enough for one bottle. Matching effects at the same level have their durations added together, and the finished fluid takes on the combined potion color.

pages.title: Splash & Enhancing
pages.text: Merge splash potions to create throwable Witch Splash instead. Finished Witch Hexbrew can also be converted into the matching form. Enhancing doubles the duration of stored effects, up to 8 minutes; effects already at the cap cannot be enhanced again. Higher tiers can merge more bottles at once. JEI shows the exact ingredients and requirements for each recipe.
